logp.method_description: Each Ru complex was first dissolved in DMSO and then diluted using phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4) to achieve a 50 uM solution containing 1% DMSO. The absorbance of the resultant aqueous solution was measured, then an equal volume of 1-octanol was added, and the two phases were mixed using an IKA Trayster digital mixer for 30 min at 60 rpm under ambient conditions. After mixing, the sample was briefly centrifuged (3 min, 4900 rpm) and the aqueous layer was carefully removed, and the absorbance spectrum was measured. Mixing was limited to 30 min so that the parent complex, rather than its ligand-exchange products, is the partitioning species.
